meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 每次回答前会先翻看以前保存的相关记忆，回答完会把新对话中的要点存起来。记忆按 agent 分组保存，容器重启后仍保留。
howto.when: 在 agent 使用默认 Claude 提供方（未设置 provider 或为 claude）时，每次对话回答前自动召回相关记忆，回答后自动存储新内容。容器启动时也会运行 mnemon setup 注册钩子。

say.text: 你还记得我们上次讨论的定价方案吗？
say.note: Claude 会从记忆中检索上次对话的相关内容并给出回答。

say.text: 今天聊的要点，以后我需要时你会想起来吗？
say.note: Claude 会把这轮对话的关键点存入长期记忆。

say.text: 新会话，谈谈我之前说的那个 bug。
say.note: Claude 能跨会话引用之前的上下文。

howto.what_en: This skill installs mnemon. Claude then recalls relevant past context before each response and stores new insights after each turn. Memory lives in the per-agent-group .claude/ mount and survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: Fires only on agent groups with the default Claude provider. It recalls relevant memory before each response and stores new insights after each turn. mnemon setup also runs on every container start to register hooks.

say_en.text: Do you remember the pricing plan we discussed last time?
say_en.note: Claude recalls the relevant memory and answers.

say_en.text: Will you remember today's key points for later?
say_en.note: Claude saves this conversation's highlights to long-term memory.

say_en.text: New session: let's talk about that bug I mentioned before.
say_en.note: Claude references prior context across sessions.
